title: Restart after rewinding
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean inputs, let $r$ be a natural number, and let $C$ be an augmented configuration in rewind phase at $(j,c)$, with $0\le j\le r$ and $0\le c\le r+1$. Suppose $j<r$. Then there is an integer $p$ with $0\le p\le |x|$ such that, for every Boolean word $u$ of length at most $p+2$, running the amplified machine from $C$ leaves all work-tape head positions unchanged; and for every such word of length exactly $p+2$, the resulting configuration is the restart of $C$ at index $j+1$ and counter $c$.
